description: Centralized API keys for autonomous usage across the platform

security.note: These are shared/public keys for community use. Never commit private keys.
security.rotationPolicy: Keys are rotated when rate limits are consistently hit
security.fallbackBehavior: System falls back to user-provided keys when shared keys are exhausted

groq.userInputPrompt: Enter your Groq API key (get free key at https://console.groq.com/keys)

keys.notes: Official demo key, returns demo data

samgov.userInputPrompt: Enter your SAM.gov API key (get free key at https://open.gsa.gov/api/)

github.userInputPrompt: Enter your GitHub Personal Access Token (create at https://github.com/settings/tokens)

openai.userInputPrompt: Enter your OpenAI API key (get from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)
openai.notes: No shared key available - users must provide their own

etherscan.userInputPrompt: Enter your Etherscan API key (get free key at https://etherscan.io/apis)

anthropic.userInputPrompt: Enter your Anthropic API key (get from https://console.anthropic.com/)
anthropic.notes: No shared key available - users must provide their own

paypal.userInputPrompt: Configure PayPal in settings (get credentials at https://developer.paypal.com/)
paypal.notes: Payment credentials must be configured per deployment

huggingface.userInputPrompt: Enter your Hugging Face API token (get from https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens)
huggingface.notes: Free tier available with account registration

poolSystem.description: Users can contribute their API keys to the community pool
